invariant: Each component keeps one fixed identity color within each palette version; no identity-color assignment is locked between versions
algorithm: All 513 assignments unlocked. CIEDE2000 plus red-green CVD-proxy graph optimization. Previous globally spaced color set reused to ensure no worst-pair regression; see docs/perceptual-palette-v0.4.md

data_provenance.gf0014_standard: GF 0014-2009, Modern Common Chinese Character Components and Component Names

data_provenance.caution: Third-party transcription contains explicitly noted OCR errors in example data (not redistributed here), duplicate visible forms, 30 non-Unicode brace-delimited descriptions and rare characters. Catalog is not certified against the original publication. Licensing of upstream standard/transcription needs independent verification.

unsupported_form_policy: Descriptive forms receive distinct IDs/colors, but cannot be correctly colored in text without verified outline/stroke geometry. Plain text retains original glyph.
